# regex-literal: regular expressions in source and configuration.
# character classes, quantifiers, escapes and groups are structure, not opaque secrets.
# word alternation alone, such as `re.compile(r"alpha|bravo|charlie")`, is not regex evidence; the word step claims it (see alternation.txt).
# known gap: the JWT allowlist regex in docs/_pages/write-a-configuration-file.md can trigger the opt-in heuristic; its literal run resembles a token.
slug_pattern = "^[a-z]+$"
upper_pattern = "[A-Z]{2,8}"
word_pattern = r"[\d_]+"
case_pattern = "(?i:[a-z]{2})"
negated_pattern = "[^]]{1,2}"
posix_pattern = "[[:alpha:]]+"
hex_pattern = r"[A-F]\d"
named_pattern = "(?P<id>[0-9]{4})"
escaped_bracket = r"[\]]\s"
compiled = re.compile(r"[a-z]{3}")
